test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the mission in which there is an attempt to boost Research and Development in the country by enabling and grooming potential PG / PhD level students by developing dedicated research skills in selected areas / disciplines / fields through high-end workshops and Training and Skill Internship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ABHYAAS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **ABHYAAS** is a mission aimed at boosting Research and Development in India.
 
• It focuses on grooming potential PG/PhD level students by developing their research skills.
 
• The program includes high-end workshops and Training and Skill Internships in selected areas/disciplines/fields.
 
• The mission is designed to create a dedicated pool of skilled researchers who can contribute significantly to various fields of study.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **KARYASHALA**

 
 
• KARYASHALA is an initiative aimed at providing hands-on training and skill development for students.
 
• It focuses on short-term training programs and workshops.
 
• The goal is to enhance the practical skills of students in various domains.
 
 
 
• **VRITIKA**
 
 
• VRITIKA is a program designed to provide internships for students in the field of research.
 
• It focuses on nurturing the research talent of students by offering them exposure to real-world research projects.
 
• The program aims to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and practical research skills.
 
 
 
• **DAKSHATA**
 
 
• DAKSHATA aims to improve the skill set of individuals in specific areas.
 
• The program includes training sessions, workshops, and seminars to develop domain-specific expertise.
 
• It is focused on creating a skilled workforce in various industries.
